partners.heroSub: We built the tool that lets anyone report illegal dumping in 60 seconds — and that shows whether anything gets done. Help us bring it to every region.
partners.problemLead: Illegal dumping is already illegal. What's missing is a shared, visible picture of where it happens — and whether it's being dealt with.

problemStats.desc: EU fine for a single illegal landfill (Zakynthos, 2024).
Greece's recycling rate vs. the EU average.
What illegal landfills have cost Greece in EU fines.

partners.problemKicker: The law isn't missing — what's missing is that anyone sees it.
partners.problemSources: Sources: European Commission / CJEU (Zakynthos ruling 2024); European Environment Agency (EEA), recycling rates 2022.
partners.solutionSub: Three steps, under 60 seconds, no account needed.

solutionSteps.title: Report
solutionSteps.desc: Snap a photo; the location is detected automatically. Under 60 seconds, no account.

solutionSteps.title: We forward
solutionSteps.desc: The report reaches the responsible municipality at its official inbox.

solutionSteps.title: Visible & tracked
solutionSteps.desc: Every report appears on the public map — with status and timing. Inaction stays visible.

partners.mvMission: To give everyone in Greece the simplest possible way to report an environmental problem — and to make it visible whether it gets fixed.
partners.mvVision: A Greece where neglect can't hide — where municipalities act because inaction is no longer invisible, and clean public space is the norm, not the exception.

claims.heading: Why GreeceClean is worth supporting
claims.sub: Six reasons, short and concrete — the core argument for support.

items.title: A real problem, sanctioned by the EU.
items.desc: Not theoretical: Greece pays millions in EU fines over waste. The problem is measurable and urgent.

items.title: We close the missing gap.
items.desc: Municipalities often don’t know where the waste is. We connect the report to visible action — the missing piece.

items.title: Few resources, big impact.
items.desc: Digital infrastructure that scales nationwide without proportional cost. Every euro of support is multiplied.

items.title: Independent, transparent, GDPR-compliant.
items.desc: Open results, clear use of funds, anonymous reporting, GDPR-compliant. No dependence on any single interest.

items.title: Data with public value.
items.desc: Aggregated, anonymised waste data — useful for policy, research, and recycling/EPR goals.

items.title: The right moment.
items.desc: EU pressure, recycling targets and the tourist season converge now. Support today has the greatest impact.

claims.partnersNote: This is where our partners will appear once confirmed. We do not show logos that are not real.

partners.whySub: The same transparent infrastructure underneath — shaped around your goals.

whyCards.title: Foundations & funders
bullets: Measurable environmental and civic impact you can report on: reports filed, cases resolved, resolution rate.
Full transparency: open data, clear use of funds, independent operation.
A lean, scalable model that turns a small grant into nationwide reach.

whyCards.title: Companies, CSR & EPR
bullets: Visible, data-backed environmental action — not a one-off campaign.
A direct contribution to zero-waste and Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) goals, with impact you can document.
Regional brand presence on a tool people genuinely use.

whyCards.title: Tourism
bullets: Show guests a destination that takes its environment seriously.
Turn visitors into part of the solution with simple on-the-spot reporting via QR.
A regional layer that links your brand to a visibly cleaner area.

whyCards.title: Municipalities & public bodies
bullets: Free reporting infrastructure that brings problems straight to the right desk.
Faster resolution and a clear record of what's been handled.
A stronger standing in the public leaderboard — proof that you act.

whyCards.title: NGOs & partners
bullets: A ready-made technology and data layer for your own campaigns.
Shared, anonymised data to back your advocacy with evidence.
Joint projects and grant applications that are stronger together.
